name: Nitin Jain
current_role: Former co-founder & Chief Business Officer, OfBusiness (left Dec 2025; new venture announced as upcoming)
profile: IIT Delhi graduate who spent seven years at Royal Bank of Scotland in London (VP, structured solutions trading) before co-founding OfBusiness in 2016, a B2B raw-material procurement and credit platform for Indian SMEs with lending arm Oxyzo. He left in Dec 2025, saying 'Something big is upcoming', hinting at manufacturing.
interesting_fact: In his Dec 2025 LinkedIn farewell from IPO-bound OfBusiness he said 'Something big is upcoming' and, asked about manufacturing, replied his next move would be 'around these lines'.
deep_cut_fact: He was a silver medalist at IIT Delhi and worked in investment banking in London, where he faced a culture shock and even unexpected layoffs, before returning to India as a founding team member of OfBusiness.

public_contacts.value: Interview: The Desi VC podcast E112 (Nitin Jain, Co-founder & CBO, OfBusiness)

notes: Left OfBusiness Dec 2025; new venture not yet named in sources found. He announced the move on LinkedIn, so LinkedIn is the likely best route. Hurun lists the $5B valuation, which belongs to OfBusiness, not his own stake. The podcast entry is a past interview he gave, not a channel he runs.

name: Logan Head
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Whatnot (livestream shopping marketplace)
profile: Engineer who co-founded Whatnot with CEO Grant LaFontaine in Los Angeles in December 2019, inspired by their shared collectibles habits; the app went through Y Combinator and grew into the leading US live-shopping marketplace, reportedly valued around $20B by 2026. Head leads engineering and product.
interesting_fact: Whatnot's first livestream test split the founders' own Funko Pop collection between static listings and live auctions; the livestreamed half sold out in about 2.5 hours, earning roughly $5,000 in one evening.
deep_cut_fact: He built Whatnot's first livestream product by shutting himself in his room for roughly four to five weeks; LaFontaine said he was 'coding 16 hours a day, six days a week,' and Head was nervous the livestream format wouldn't work.
notes: Low public profile; LaFontaine is the public face. No official Whatnot press email found (only in-app support). Pre-Whatnot roles (GOAT, Flight Club) appear only in third-party profiles and were not confirmed from primary sources.

name: Austin Woodward
current_role: Co-founder and Executive Chairman, TaxBit (CEO until June 2023)
profile: Accountant-turned-founder who co-founded Utah-based TaxBit in 2017 with his brother Justin, a tax attorney, to automate tax reporting for crypto/digital assets. As CEO he raised about $230M (Paradigm, Tiger Global, IVP, Insight) and built enterprise and government businesses; in June 2023 he handed the CEO role to COO Lindsey Argalas and became chairman.
interesting_fact: TaxBit's $100M Series A in 2021, led by Paradigm and Tiger Global, was reported as the largest Series A in Utah history.
deep_cut_fact: He prefers the term 'digital assets' over 'cryptocurrency' because it covers more, and has said running a business is 'brutally transparent and honest'.
notes: The press email comes from a June 2023 TaxBit release. Secondary sources (podcast notes and directories) say he was a CPA and an early Qualtrics hire, but no primary source confirmed it, so it is not used above. His involvement has been chairman-level since 2023.

name: Justin Borgman
current_role: Co-founder, Chairman and CEO, Starburst (Trino-based data platform)
profile: Former software engineer who, while at business school, co-founded Hadapt (2010) to commercialize Yale's HadoopDB research and sold it to Teradata in 2014, where he became VP/GM of Hadoop products. He then co-founded Starburst with the Trino (Presto) creators. Starburst now sells an open-lakehouse/AI data platform, including a GPU-native engine launched in 2026.
interesting_fact: In 2026 Starburst named 2025 F1 world champion Lando Norris as its brand ambassador; Borgman likened enterprise AI to an F1 driver's split-second, data-driven decisions.
deep_cut_fact: While in business school he read the HadoopDB paper by Yale researchers Daniel Abadi and Kamil Bajda-Pawlikowski, walked over to the CS department to recruit them, and started Hadapt. He calls it 'basically like getting a Ph.D. in entrepreneurship.' Bajda-Pawlikowski later co-founded Starburst with him.
notes: A frequent speaker and podcast guest on data/AI infrastructure, which makes him a strong fit for a data-center/AI podcast. The best route is through Starburst's PR agency, AirCover.

name: Ramasubramaniam B
current_role: Co-founder, Executive Director and Head - New Initiatives, BlackBuck (Zinka Logistics Solutions)
profile: Ramasubramaniam (Ramasubramanian) Balasubramaniam is a logistics veteran with about 27 years of experience, associated with supply-chain advisory Miebach Consulting India. In 2015 he co-founded BlackBuck, India's largest digital trucking platform, with Rajesh Yabaji and Chanakya Hridaya, and holds a roughly 10.7% stake per the 2024 DRHP.
interesting_fact: In BlackBuck's 2024 IPO filing the three co-founders held almost identical stakes: Ramasubramaniam and Yabaji 10.67% each, Hridaya 10.68%.
deep_cut_fact: Unlike his two IIT Kharagpur co-founders, he came from the consulting side: he holds a PGDBM from the Institute of Integrated Learning in Management (IILM) and remains a director of Miebach Consulting India alongside his BlackBuck role.
notes: Very low public profile; CEO Rajesh Yabaji is BlackBuck's public face. His name is also spelled Ramasubramanian Balasubramaniam. Accounts differ on how he met Yabaji (an ITC project vs. Miebach).

name: Izabel Jelenic
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, Infobip
profile: Croatian engineer who co-founded Infobip with CEO Silvio Kutić in 2006 in Vodnjan, a town of about 6,000 on the Istrian peninsula, starting with a €25,000 loan. Infobip grew into a global cloud communications (CPaaS) platform and Croatia's first unicorn. As CTO he leads 800+ engineers across continents.
interesting_fact: Infobip's seed idea was a Christmas SMS sent from Vodnjan's town hall to the town's diaspora community.
deep_cut_fact: In Infobip's early days he was the entire technical side: 'When we founded Infobip, there were just two of us, and I was doing almost everything on the technical side,' from development and deployment to customer support and hiring. Now leading 800+ engineers, he says he still misses the hands-on work.

public_contacts.value: Infobip media kit / media team contacts

notes: Izabel is a male Croatian name; sources refer to Jelenić as 'he'. He is lower profile than CEO Silvio Kutić. Infobip's media kit lists named PR staff rather than a generic press inbox. Infobip is pushing into European AI/cloud infrastructure, which could be a podcast angle.
